zh: 设置页「动效」页新增「新文字淡入」一行：流式回答里新出现的字符是否先淡后实（约 0.12 秒）由它决定，两档各带一张预览卡，同一句样品在卡里逐字到达，「淡入」那张每个字先落到最淡的一档再亮起来，「直接出现」那张把字一个个直接交出来；这一项默认关闭，关闭时新到的字符立即是本色。
en: The Motion tab gains a New-text fade row, deciding whether the characters arriving in a streaming answer start faint and settle over about 0.12 s; its two cards each hold the same sample line arriving character by character, the Fade in card landing each character at its faintest step before it brightens and the Appears at once card handing each one over as it is. The row ships off, and with it off arriving characters are solid at once.
